infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Klarity uses the camera to capture photos inside the app before you publish them.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Klarity uses the microphone to record audio tracks that the app attaches to your creations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Klarity accesses your photo library to let you choose media that appears in the app.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Klarity uses speech recognition to turn your spoken words into text inside the app.
